findings.finding_text: Multi-model evidence is page-order sensitive: a failed row encountered first short-circuits before a completed row for another triggered model (auditor F-A).

findings.rationale: gate widened to any leading-dash arg; case 22 pins exit 2 at the real CLI boundary.
